authorized: Local source read and bounded source-only test controls; no native/browser/renderer/DB/Docker/cloud/paid/provider execution

criteria.assertion: Exact root allocation and author freeze; canonical integrated worker/browser/artifact owner entry must consume the implementation. A disconnected generic helper or synthetic demonstration cannot close the source call-path gap.

Use canonical public full RunBinding with tenant/actor/conversation/run/attempt/worker/fence and immutable task/resource correlation. Task A cannot use, publish from or clean task B resources; stale replacement and cross-tenant substitution deny before effects.

Trusted raw context is bounded, validated and immutably snapshotted before await. Model/user arguments cannot establish resource ownership, path, approval, authority, deadline or artifact publication scope. Accessors/proxies and post-await mutations do not broaden authority.

Current authority and all known expiries/deadlines bind acquisition, browser/render operation, inspection and final publication. Earliest known ceiling applies before any downstream await; park each boundary, revoke/replace while parked and prove late completion starts no new effect or successful output.

Explicit cancellation, expiry, error and normal completion run one bounded cleanup path. Late acquisition after cancellation must remain owned and receive scoped cleanup or explicitly retained uncertainty; rejected waiting is not physical cancellation.

Clean only exact resources created/acquired for this task by this owner. Never close borrowed clients/pools/shared roots or broad process groups; preserve unrelated task B resources and original source/failure artifacts.

Cleanup acknowledgement/request/timeout is never proof of physical teardown. Exact positive current resource/process absence readback is required to claim confirmed teardown; wrong identity, unknown, parked or failed observation remains UNKNOWN and cannot permit reuse or publication.

Artifact bytes are inspected before publication against exact task/version identity, bounded size, digest, type/format and path containment. Revalidate immutable bytes or bind inspected bytes to published bytes; reject tamper, symlink/path escape, stale version, foreign task and failed/partial inspection.

Publication consumes fresh task-bound authority and validated canonical ArtifactVersion/current immutable object metadata when relevant; no successful receipt on late, partial, failed or acknowledgement-unknown publication. Preserve uncertainty and do not retry publication automatically.

Safe import/construction creates no listener, native browser/renderer, subprocess, filesystem output or external connection. Default source/native execution remains disabled; any newly introduced entry cannot bypass current G1/image/security approvals.

Preserve original tests, negative controls, schemas, dependencies, catalog, immutable evidence and approved SDK/Temporal/Playwright/AI SDK responsibilities. Modular responsibilities and allocated new paths; no legacy Capiro implementation/host skill imports or new runtime framework.

Independent source controls must traverse the actual new integrated entry, retain failures and meaningful mutants, bind exact SHA/tree/source hashes, and distinguish scripted port/source evidence from real browser/renderer sandbox, native descendant death, artifact rendering/visual quality and runtime gate acceptance.
